coco_wholebody.name: COCO-WholeBody v1.0 / COCO2017 images
coco_wholebody.annotation_license: CC-BY-4.0; upstream additionally limits the dataset to research and non-commercial use
coco_wholebody.authors: Sheng Jin, Lumin Xu, Jin Xu, Can Wang, Wentao Liu, Chen Qian, Wanli Ouyang and Ping Luo; annotations owned by SenseTime Research
coco_wholebody.citation: Jin et al. Whole-Body Human Pose Estimation in the Wild. ECCV 2020.
coco_wholebody.modifications: Keep the source's 133-label annotation indexing in prepared metadata, then select only the 73 declared body, finger, foot and face targets for model supervision. Person crops, resizing, coordinate normalization and invalid annotation exclusion. No duplicate hand-root outputs. Per-image license IDs and original source URLs are retained in dataset_manifest.json.

aspset510.name: ASPset-510 v1
aspset510.authors: Aiden Nibali, Joshua Millward, Zhen He and Stuart Morgan; La Trobe University and the Australian Institute of Sport
aspset510.citation: ASPset: An Outdoor Sports Pose Video Dataset With 3D Keypoint Annotations. Image and Vision Computing 2021, 104196. DOI:10.1016/j.imavis.2021.104196
aspset510.modifications: Select the 12 anatomical joints shared with COCO5..16; calibrated camera projection; camera-axis normalization; hip-midpoint subtraction; meters; frame subsampling. No ASPset RGB video required.
